newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SHARES MIXED, HERMIS DOMINATES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SHARES MIXED, HERMIS DOMINATES TRADE.

text.p: Hermis Bank kept the Vilnius bourse relatively active on Wednesday, accounting for over half of central market turnover in a day of mixed trading.
Official list shares eased 4.63 points to 939.64 points, while the broader group A list advanced 5.82 points to 1838.24 points.
Hermis held steady at 210 litas and domintated trading, with 447,000 litas of the central market's 744,000 litas turnover.
"Maybe next week it will reach 215 litas," said one broker. "Many shareholders have sold what they wanted to and they'll wait to see what happens."
Hermis was active in block trading as well, turning over 1.05 million litas at 210 litas.
Brokers say Hermis will start gaining ground on the more expensive Vilniaus Bank shares, which were unchanged at 245 litas amid central market turnover of a mere 17,640 litas.
Vilniaus Bank also turned over 490,000 litas in block trades at 245 litas.
"I think 245 is a normal price for Vilniaus Bank," said one broker. "I don't think it will increase and maybe it will go down to 240."
Medienos Plaushas, one of three corporates on the official list, dropped to 11.80 litas amid thin central market turnover.

The company said on Thursday its profits for the first six months were 1.8 million litas, up from 1.3 million litas in the same period last year but shy of the 2 million litas the company had projected.
Brokers say the fall came too early in the day to be influenced by the result, which they said would have minimal impact on its price anyway.
Dealers say low demand in general for Medienos shares exaggerates its price fluctuations.
"It's not very popular among our customers," said on dealer.
